थलाइवा मचाने वाले हैं बॉक्स ऑफिस पर सबसे बड़ा धमाल! 🔥
सुपरस्टार रजनीकांत की फिल्म Jailer 2 दुनिया भर में इतिहास रचने के बेहद करीब पहुंच गई है।
Nelson Dilipkumar के निर्देशन में बनी इस एक्शन थ्रिलर फिल्म ने 16 दिनों में worldwide box office पर 779.29 करोड़ रुपये का gross collection कर लिया है।
रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक अब फिल्म 800 crore club में एंट्री करने से सिर्फ 20 करोड़ रुपये दूर है।
Diwali weekend पर अंतरराष्ट्रीय बाजारों और मजबूत festive footfalls के चलते यह रिकॉर्ड जल्द टूटने की उम्मीद है।
कोविड के बाद से रजनीकांत की पांच theatrical releases का कुल worldwide box office collection 2,324.41 crore रुपये हो चुका है।
क्या आपको लगता है कि Jailer 2 इस दिवाली 800 करोड़ का जादुई आंकड़ा पार कर लेगी? 🎬

ctx.title: Jailer 2 Worldwide Box Office: Rajinikanth All Set To Deliver The First 800 Crore Club Opener Of Kollywood This Diwali?
ctx.summary:
Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 is still earning at the box office and it is very close to inaugurate the 800 crore club globally - WW box office report. 
 The post  Jailer 2 Worldwide Box Office: Rajinikanth All Set To Deliver The First 800 Crore Club Opener Of Kollywood This Diwali?  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Rajinikanth is on the brink of writing history for Tamil cinema with his latest release, Jailer 2. Helmed by director Nelson Dilipkumar, the high-octane action thriller has turned into an unstoppable global phenomenon ever since its theatrical debut. It is already the highest-grossing film of Kollywood globally, and now it is moving towards the next milestone!
Currently sitting at a staggering 779.29 crore gross collection at the worldwide box office in 16 days, Rajinikanth is almost 20 crore away from a very major milestone for Kollywood, which obviously none have achieved since Rajinikanth only holds the crown for the highest grosser!
Jailer 2 is very close to the 800 crore club, and looking at the pace of the film, it will surely reach this mark at the box office! With steady numbers across international territories and strong festive footfalls continuing into the Diwali weekend, Rajinikanth is set to lock in an unprecedented landmark for Tamil cinema.
The historical run of Jailer 2 further solidifies Rajinikanth’s position as the box office titan of South Indian cinema. Across his five post-COVID theatrical releases, the Superstar has accumulated a total worldwide box office collection of 2,324.41 crore !
Check out the worldwide collection of Rajinikanth’s post-COVID releases at the box office.
Having smashed past 779 crore worldwide, Jailer 2 continues to redefine theatrical metrics for Kollywood. As festive audiences pour into theaters across Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh/Telangana, North America, and Gulf circuits over Diwali, Superstar Rajinikanth is set to inaugurate the historic 800 Crore Club!
